dataset_name: Sloan Digital Sky Survey DR18 Photometric & Spectroscopic Survey
source: SDSS SkyServer CasJobs Catalog Archive (SpecObjAll joined with PhotoObjAll)
sql_query: SELECT TOP 1500 p.objid, p.ra, p.dec, p.u, p.g, p.r, p.i, p.z, s.class, s.z as redshift FROM PhotoObjAll p JOIN SpecObjAll s ON p.objid = s.bestobjid WHERE s.class IN ('STAR', 'GALAXY', 'QSO') AND s.zWarning = 0 AND p.clean = 1
